context: M15 o1. Hotel Pennsylvania ballroom, a furriers' trade dinner. Chandeliers flicker. Nick at the head table.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Gentlemen. In Kastoria we say the beaver doesn't ask who wears the coat.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I am a beaver. You are all beavers. We work. Somebody else gets warm.

lines.speaker: char.stavros_kallis
lines.text: Niko, the lights. Even the hotel is losing faith in you.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: The lights are applauding, Stavros. In Morse code.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: …The lights are applauding all over Thirtieth Street. Excuse me.
